metadata.title: Interactive Tajweed Graph
metadata.description: Explore Makharijul Huruf and Sifatul Huruf through an interactive graph visualization. See how hijaiyyah letters connect to their articulation points and traits.

legend.title: Legend
legend.trait_lazimah_description: Permanent Trait is a trait that is always present in a letter.
legend.trait_aridhah_description: Conditional Trait is a trait that is only present in a letter under certain conditions.

welcome.title: Assalamualaikum!
welcome.description: Welcome to Tajweed Playground. May Allah ease your journey in learning Tajweed through this interactive visualization. Let's begin, Bismillah...

canvas.title: Interactive Area
canvas.description: This is the main area to explore the relationships between letters, Makhraj, and Sifat, complete with display settings and legends.

controls.title: View Controls
controls.description: Use scroll or +/- buttons to zoom, drag to pan, the square icon to center the graph, and the lock icon to freeze the graph layout.

graph_filter.title: Settings Panel
graph_filter.description: Here you can adjust the graph display according to your needs. Please click to open the settings panel.

view_mode.title: View Mode
view_mode.description: Choose what to display: All, Makhraj only, Sifat only, or focus on a specific Letter. Please click 'Letter' to continue.

letter_selector.title: Hijaiyyah Selection
letter_selector.description: Masya Allah, there are 29 Hijaiyyah letters to explore. Select one letter to see its Makhraj and Sifat in detail.

layout_mode.title: Layout Mode
layout_mode.description: Choose between Radial layout (circular like the sun) or Hierarchy (tiered like a tree). Please try the Hierarchy mode.

hierarchy_direction.title: Hierarchy Direction
hierarchy_direction.description: Set the flow direction: Vertical (top to bottom) or Horizontal (left to right). Please select Horizontal.

edge_style.title: Edge Style
edge_style.description: Enable dynamic lines that follow node positions, or disable to select static line shapes. Please disable it to see line shape options.

edge_shape.title: Edge Shape
edge_shape.description: Choose the connecting line shape: Bezier (smooth curve), Straight, Step, or Smoothstep.

graph_legend.title: Color Legend
graph_legend.description: This panel explains the meaning of each node color. Please open it to continue.

legend_detail.title: Detail Info
legend_detail.description: This icon can be clicked to read more detailed explanations.

node_letter.title: Hijaiyyah Letters
node_letter.description: These solid orange nodes represent the Hijaiyyah letters. Click to see the Makhraj and Sifat attached to the letter.

node_articulation_point.title: Specific Makhraj
node_articulation_point.description: These outlined blue nodes indicate a specific Makhraj (Articulation Point), where the letter is emitted.

node_articulation_area.title: General Makhraj
node_articulation_area.description: These solid blue nodes indicate a general Makhraj (Area) which contains several specific Makhraj points within it.

node_trait.title: Letter Sifat
node_trait.description: These outlined purple nodes represent the Sifat (Characteristics) inherent in the Hijaiyyah letters.

node_trait_group.title: Sifat Group
node_trait_group.description: These solid purple nodes group together several Sifat that are paired or related to each other.
